family_title_en: Spell words with ch, sh, th, ph, wh, ng, nk, qu, and x

stages.ix_title: Spell words with ch, sh, th, ph, wh, ng, nk, qu, and x

what_to_do.en: Tap the word spelled the right way.

stages.choice_rule: Four whole-word choices. One is the correct spelling of the word the stem points to. The other three are misspellings of that same word, never a different real word. Vary answer_index. Set media to one lemma, the correct word.

gold_items.stem: A big boat on the sea.
The mouse ate this yellow food.
Snow is this color in winter.
You sing this with your class.
You do this with your brain.
You ask this when you need help.
You call your family on this at home.

roots: Wrong choices are misspellings of the target word. Never use a different real word.
Break ch, sh, th, ph, wh, ng, nk, qu, or final x. Do not invent a new word.
Tier 1 drops a letter, repeats a letter, or swaps ch with sh in a one-syllable word.
Tier 2 swaps a vowel, drops h in wh or th, or spells nk as nck.
Tier 3 changes one letter or the letter order. Trade ph for f and qu for kw.
Use school, home, food, pets, play, family, or weather. No brand names and no real child names.
Cover ch, sh, th, ph, wh, ng, nk, qu, and x in the pool. Do not skip ph, qu, or x.

tier_rules.1: Stems of four to six words. One-syllable words such as ship, cheese, and six. Wrong choices drop a letter, repeat a letter, or swap ch with sh.
tier_rules.2: Stems of about six words. Words such as white, song, and think. Wrong choices are closer: a wrong vowel, a missing h, or nk spelled nck.
tier_rules.3: Stems of seven to ten words. Longer words such as question and phone. Wrong choices keep almost every letter, or trade ph for f and qu for kw.

sh_spell.en: Ship is spelled s, h, i, p. The first two letters are s and h.
sh_spell.ko: ship은 s, h, i, p로 씁니다. 앞의 두 글자는 s와 h입니다.

ch_spell.en: Cheese is spelled c, h, e, e, s, e. The first two letters are c and h.
ch_spell.ko: cheese는 c, h, e, e, s, e로 씁니다. 앞의 두 글자는 c와 h입니다.

x_spell.en: Six is spelled s, i, x. The last letter is x.
x_spell.ko: six는 s, i, x로 씁니다. 마지막 글자는 x입니다.

wh_spell.en: White is spelled w, h, i, t, e. The first two letters are w and h.
wh_spell.ko: white는 w, h, i, t, e로 씁니다. 앞의 두 글자는 w와 h입니다.

ng_spell.en: Song is spelled s, o, n, g. The last two letters are n and g.
ng_spell.ko: song은 s, o, n, g로 씁니다. 끝의 두 글자는 n과 g입니다.

th_nk_spell.en: Think is spelled t, h, i, n, k. It starts with t, h and ends with n, k.
th_nk_spell.ko: think는 t, h, i, n, k로 씁니다. t, h로 시작하고 n, k로 끝납니다.

qu_spell.en: Question starts with q, u. It is spelled q, u, e, s, t, i, o, n.
qu_spell.ko: question은 q, u로 시작합니다. q, u, e, s, t, i, o, n으로 씁니다.

ph_spell.en: Phone starts with p, h. It is spelled p, h, o, n, e.
ph_spell.ko: phone은 p, h로 시작합니다. p, h, o, n, e로 씁니다.
